quests.instruction: The last question of the curriculum: transfer everything. Sort these figurative uses into Elementary or Convoluted.
quests.definition: 'Boils down to one idea' and 'elegantly simple' both praise clarity achieved through effort — reaching simplicity is usually harder than leaving something complicated. 'Ties itself in knots', 'a maze of exceptions', and 'buried under caveats' all describe complexity that obscures meaning rather than adding to it, which is the difference this whole curriculum has been training you to hear.
